stemMd: On the interval 0 ≤ x < 2π, how many solutions does cos x = −1/2 have?
explanationMd: The reference angle is π/3. Cosine is negative in the second and third quadrants, giving x = 2π/3 and x = 4π/3. Both lie in the interval and there are no others in one full cycle.

distractorRationale.b: This misses one of the two quadrants where cosine is negative.
distractorRationale.d: There are only two crossings of this level in one full period.
distractorRationale.e: Four solutions would require an equation with a different symmetry or frequency.
distractorRationale.a: Cosine takes the value −1/2 within its range.
